lines.gurmukhi: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਆਖਿ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਆਖਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: aakhan aukhaa naanakaa aakh na jaapai aakh ||2||
lines.translation: It is so difficult to chant it, O Nanak; it cannot be chanted with the mouth. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਸੀਐ ਨਾਮੇ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai suniai man rahaseeai naame saa(n)t aaee ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name, the mind is delighted. The Name brings peace and tranquility.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੀਐ ਸਭ ਦੁਖ ਗਵਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai suniai man tripateeai sabh dukh gavaaee ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name, the mind is satisfied, and all pains are taken away.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਨਾਉ ਊਪਜੈ ਨਾਮੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai suniai naau oopajai naame vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name, one becomes famous; the Name brings glorious greatness.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਮੇ ਹੀ ਸਭ ਜਾਤਿ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੇ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naame hee sabh jaat pat naame gat paaee ||
lines.translation: The Name brings all honor and status; through the Name, salvation is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੬॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh naam dhiaaeeai naanak liv laaee ||6||
lines.translation: The Gurmukh meditates on the Name; Nanak is lovingly attuned to the Name. ||6||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਰਾਗਂੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਵੇਦਂੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jooth na raaga(n)ee jooth na veda(n)ee ||
lines.translation: Impurity does not come from music; impurity does not come from the Vedas.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਚੰਦ ਸੂਰਜ ਕੀ ਭੇਦੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jooth na cha(n)d sooraj kee bhedee ||
lines.translation: Impurity does not come from the phases of the sun and the moon.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਅੰਨੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਨਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jooth na a(n)nee jooth na naaee ||
lines.translation: Impurity does not come from food; impurity does not come from ritual cleansing baths.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਮੀਹੁ ਵਰ੍ਹਿਐ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jooth na meehu varhiai sabh thaaee ||
lines.translation: Impurity does not come from the rain, which falls everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਧਰਤੀ ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jooth na dharatee jooth na paanee ||
lines.translation: Impurity does not come from the earth; impurity does not come from the water.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੂਠਿ ਨ ਪਉਣੈ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: jooth na paunai maahi samaanee ||
lines.translation: Impurity does not come from the air which is diffused everywhere.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਗੁਰਿਆ ਗੁਣੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak niguriaa gun naahee koi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the one who has no Guru, has no redeeming virtues at all.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੁਹਿ ਫੇਰਿਐ ਮੁਹੁ ਜੂਠਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: muhi pheriai muhu joothaa hoi ||1||
lines.translation: Impurity comes from turning one's face away from God. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਚੁਲੀਆ ਸੁਚੀਆ ਜੇ ਭਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak chuleeaa sucheeaa je bhar jaanai koi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, the mouth is truly cleansed by ritual cleansing, if you really know how to do it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਤੇ ਚੁਲੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਕੀ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਾ ਜਤੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: surate chulee giaan kee jogee kaa jat hoi ||
lines.translation: For the intuitively aware, cleansing is spiritual wisdom. For the Yogi, it is self-control.

lines.gurmukhi: ਬ੍ਰਹਮਣ ਚੁਲੀ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਕੀ ਗਿਰਹੀ ਕਾ ਸਤੁ ਦਾਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: brahaman chulee sa(n)tokh kee girahee kaa sat daan ||
lines.translation: For the Brahmin, cleansing is contentment; for the householder, it is truth and charity.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਚੁਲੀ ਨਿਆਵ ਕੀ ਪੜਿਆ ਸਚੁ ਧਿਆਨੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: raaje chulee niaav kee paRiaa sach dhiaan ||
lines.translation: For the king, cleansing is justice; for the scholar, it is true meditation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਨ ਧੋਪਈ ਮੁਖਿ ਪੀਤੈ ਤਿਖ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: paanee chit na dhopaee mukh peetai tikh jaai ||
lines.translation: The consciousness is not washed with water; you drink it to quench your thirst.

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਾਣੀ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਗਤ ਕਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਸਭੁ ਖਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: paanee pitaa jagat kaa phir paanee sabh khaai ||2||
lines.translation: Water is the father of the world; in the end, water destroys it all. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਭ ਸਿਧਿ ਹੈ ਰਿਧਿ ਪਿਛੈ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai suniai sabh sidh hai ridh pichhai aavai ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name, all supernatural spiritual powers are obtained, and wealth follows along.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਨਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai suniai nau nidh milai man chi(n)diaa paavai ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name, the nine treasures are received, and the mind's desires are obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੰਤੋਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਕਵਲਾ ਚਰਨ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai suniai sa(n)tokh hoi kavalaa charan dhiaavai ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name, contentment comes, and Maya meditates at one's feet.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸਹਜੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai suniai sahaj oopajai sahaje sukh paavai ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name, intuitive peace and poise wells up.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਈਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੭॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee naau paaeeai naanak gun gaavai ||7||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the Name is obtained; O Nanak, sing His Glorious Praises. ||7||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੰਮਣੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਮਰਣੁ ਦੁਖਿ ਵਰਤਣੁ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh vich ja(n)man dukh maran dukh varatan sa(n)saar ||
lines.translation: In pain, we are born; in pain, we die. In pain, we deal with the world.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਗੈ ਆਖੀਐ ਪੜੑਿ ਪੜੑਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh dukh agai aakheeai paRhi paRhi karahi pukaar ||
lines.translation: Hereafter, there is said to be pain, only pain; the more the mortals read, the more they cry out.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਕੀਆ ਪੰਡਾ ਖੁਲੑੀਆ ਸੁਖੁ ਨ ਨਿਕਲਿਓ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh keeaa pa(n)daa khulheeaa sukh na nikalio koi ||
lines.translation: The packages of pain are untied, but peace does not emerge.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਵਿਚਿ ਜੀਉ ਜਲਾਇਆ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਚਲਿਆ ਰੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: dukh vich jeeu jalaaiaa dukheeaa chaliaa roi ||
lines.translation: In pain, the soul burns; in pain, it departs weeping and wailing.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਿਫਤੀ ਰਤਿਆ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਰਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak siphatee ratiaa man tan hariaa hoi ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, imbued with the Lord's Praise, the mind and body blossom forth, rejuvenated.

lines.gurmukhi: ਦੁਖ ਕੀਆ ਅਗੀ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਭੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dukh keeaa agee maareeahi bhee dukh daaroo hoi ||1||
lines.translation: In the fire of pain, the mortals die; but pain is also the cure. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਭਸੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਭਸੂ ਹੂ ਭਸੁ ਖੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanak duneeaa bhas ra(n)g bhasoo hoo bhas kheh ||
lines.translation: O Nanak, worldly pleasures are nothing more than dust. They are the dust of the dust of ashes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਭਸੋ ਭਸੁ ਕਮਾਵਣੀ ਭੀ ਭਸੁ ਭਰੀਐ ਦੇਹ ॥
lines.transliteration: bhaso bhas kamaavanee bhee bhas bhareeai deh ||
lines.translation: The mortal earns only the dust of the dust; his body is covered with dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਜੀਉ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਕਢੀਐ ਭਸੂ ਭਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa jeeu vichahu kadheeai bhasoo bhariaa jaai ||
lines.translation: When the soul is taken out of the body, it too is covered with dust.

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਗੈ ਲੇਖੈ ਮੰਗਿਐ ਹੋਰ ਦਸੂਣੀ ਪਾਇ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: agai lekhai ma(n)giai hor dasoonee paai ||2||
lines.translation: And when one's account is called for in the world hereafter, he receives only ten times more dust. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
lines.transliteration: pauRee ||
lines.translation: Pauree:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਸੁਚਿ ਸੰਜਮੋ ਜਮੁ ਨੇੜਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai suniai such sa(n)jamo jam neR na aavai ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name, one is blessed with purity and self-control, and the Messenger of Death will not draw near.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਘਟਿ ਚਾਨਣਾ ਆਨੑੇਰੁ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai suniai ghat chaananaa aanher gavaavai ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name, the heart is illumined, and darkness is dispelled.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਆਪੁ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਲਾਹਾ ਨਾਉ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai suniai aap bujheeai laahaa naau paavai ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name, one comes to understand his own self, and the profit of the Name is obtained.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਪਾਪ ਕਟੀਅਹਿ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: naai suniai paap kateeahi niramal sach paavai ||
lines.translation: Hearing the Name, sins are eradicated, and one meets the Immaculate True Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਇ ਸੁਣਿਐ ਮੁਖ ਉਜਲੇ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥੮॥
lines.transliteration: naanak naai suniai mukh ujale naau guramukh dhiaavai ||8||
lines.translation: O Nanak, hearing the Name, one's face becomes radiant. As Gurmukh, meditate on the Name. ||8||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
lines.transliteration: salok mahalaa 1 ||
lines.translation: Salok, First Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਰਿ ਨਾਰਾਇਣੁ ਸਭਾ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghar naaraain sabhaa naal ||
lines.translation: In your home, is the Lord God, along with all your other gods.
